issues.description: setuptools<82 cap leaks build-tool constraint into core runtime install_requires
issues.detail: The mmcv/pkg_resources problem is a build-time CI issue, but the pin landed in core/setup.py's install_requires for the hyperopt extra. That conflates build-time and runtime contracts and forces every downstream user of autogluon.core to accept the ceiling. Move the cap to CI scripts or pyproject build-system requires.

issues.description: setuptools<82 constraint is duplicated across three sites with no shared spec or revert criteria
issues.detail: The same pin appears in env_setup.sh, setup_mmcv.sh, and core/setup.py with FIXMEs that reference mmcv#3325 but never state the revert condition or owner. When upstream resolves, one of the three sites will be missed. State the trigger ("once mmcv ships a wheel that doesn't import pkg_resources at build") in one place.

issues.description: mmcv installed with --no-build-isolation implicitly couples build to ambient env state
issues.detail: Disabling build isolation means mmcv's build depends on whatever torch, ninja, setuptools, and wheel the runner provides. It works today because the script pre-pins setuptools<82 and torch is preinstalled upstream, but the implicit precondition is undocumented. Add a comment stating the required ambient deps or install them explicitly.

issues.description: mmengine and mmdet version substitutions land without rationale in the diff
issues.detail: The PR replaces a pinned mmengine git SHA (chosen for torch 2.5 compatibility) with mmengine==0.10.7 and bumps mmdet 3.2.0 to 3.3.0. The prior torch-2.5 invariant is dropped without confirming the new pins satisfy it, and the mmdet bump rides a bug-fix PR. Add a one-line note or split the mmdet bump.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges: the CI fix is reasonable in shape (cap setuptools below the version that drops pkg_resources, pin mmengine to a released version), but the patch crosses boundaries it shouldn't. The strongest shared concern is that setuptools<82 leaked into core/setup.py's runtime install_requires, propagating a build-tool ceiling to downstream users of autogluon.core. The same constraint is now duplicated across three locations with FIXMEs that lack a revert condition, making cleanup fragile when mmcv#3325 resolves. Secondary concerns are --no-build-isolation silently depending on ambient env state, and undocumented mmengine/mmdet version substitutions that drop the prior torch-2.5 invariant. Verdict: needs-work — keep the cap in CI, document the revert trigger, justify the version bumps.
